name: avichian
description: Avichian — private campus platform for Avichi Arts and Science College

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,app,admin -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w @avichian/student-app" "npm run dev -w @avichian/super-admin-portal"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w @avichian/student-app"
scripts.dev:admin: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w @avichian/super-admin-portal"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w @avichian/student-app && npm run build -w @avichian/super-admin-portal
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w @avichian/student-app && npm run lint -w @avichian/super-admin-portal
